      • ACTION_POE_CHANGED

        public static final java.lang.String ACTION_POE_CHANGED

        Broadcast Action: power source switched into or out of PoE.

        To save power when power source is PoE, device will disable some functions, such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GPS, HDMI output, GPIO output and USB hub ports. when power source switched to AC adapter, recovery these functions to the last state. The intent will have the following extra value:

        • state - A boolean value indicating whether PoE is on.

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • isPoeOn

        public boolean isPoeOn()
        Whether the power source is PoE now.
        Returns:
        true if power source is PoE, and false if power source is AC adapter.

        Note1: If current model supports PoE feature (e.g. model is "Elo-i2-10Std"), but not plug-in PoE module, force return false.

        Note2: If current model doesn't support PoE feature (e.g. model is "Elo-PP-15") , force return false.

      • geEthernetLinkModeCtl

        public EloPeripheralManager.EthernetLinkMode geEthernetLinkModeCtl()
        Get the Ethernet link mode instance to control ethernet speed and duplex like as ethtool.

        The model that has Ethernet feature supports this feature.

        Note: Make sure Ethernet device exist when you want to control ethernet speed and duplex.

      • getExtLedCtl

        public EloPeripheralManager.ExtLed getExtLedCtl()
        Get the external LED instance to turn on/off the external LED device which connects to i-series with two usb ports

        Note:

        1. When user enable external LED, platform will turn on external LED's usb ports automatically.

        2. User is not allowed to disable external LED's usb ports in UI while external LED is on.

        3. if external LED is on, external LED's usb ports will not off when power source changed to PoE

        These models support usb port enable/disable feature:

        "Elo-i2-10Std" (i-series 2.0)

        "Elo-i2-15Std" (i-series 2.0)

        "Elo-i2-22Std" (i-series 2.0)
